headword: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}

definitions.gloss: field trip; off-campus learning; outdoor study
definitions.explanation: Educational activities conducted outside the school, such as visits to museums, factories, nature parks, or historical sites. A regular part of the Japanese school curriculum.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}{校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}がある。
examples.english: There is a field trip next week.

examples.japanese: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}で{博物館|はくぶつかん}を{見学|けんがく}した。
examples.english: We visited a museum on our field trip.

examples.japanese: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}の{日|ひ}は{弁当|べんとう}を{持参|じさん}することになっている。
examples.english: On field trip days, students are supposed to bring their own lunches.

notes: Compound of {校外|こうがい} (off-campus) + {学習|がくしゅう} (learning/study). Japanese schools regularly conduct {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう} as part of the curriculum. Related terms: {遠足|えんそく} (excursion, usually shorter and more recreational), {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう} (school trip, usually multi-day), {社会科見学|しゃかいかけんがく} (social studies field trip). Common collocation: {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}に{行|い}く (to go on a field trip).
